verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no mention of Mixpanel's identity resolution features (e.g., identify(), $merge, alias, distinct_id merging) for tying anonymous pre-signup activity to an identified user profile. While this is a well-known Mixpanel capability generally, none of the provided docs, community posts, or probes reference it, so per the evidence-only rule this must be judged as unsupported.
